## What

Turn the B1.3 loader into a library with the calls the real camera will need:
**configure, trigger, capture N seconds, report status**. In B3.3 the real
camera goes in behind this same interface, so nothing above it should change.

## Done when

- [ ] UTAT can run a replayed pass using **only documented calls**.
- [ ] The calls are documented in `docs/CAMERA_API.md`, including error and
      status reporting (dropped frames, storage full, timeout).

## Notes

Replaces `C-03` (camera control UART master) and `D-05` (CSR map freeze): on the
K26, camera control and status live in this library on the ARM, not in fabric
registers.
